title: Read market rules and return to the same menu
description: Actual shared GameMenu and MarketRules in the production gallery. Local navigation only; this does not establish live campaign draft/tick preservation or authoritative actions.

steps.description: Open the shared menu and Rules with the keyboard, then expand the existing market chapter.
steps.acknowledgement: The actual market chapter opens inside the single existing modal.
verifications: The top heading, chapter entry and rule-review disclosure are wholly within the reading clip while both footer actions remain contained.
Reading continues the campaign and cannot be confused with leaving or surrendering; proposed rules retain their disclosure.

steps.description: Shift+Tab from the chapter entry into the named bounded reading region, then use End to read confirmed and held returns without moving the footer.
steps.acknowledgement: Keyboard scrolling reveals the complete lower heading and its relevant paragraph.
verifications: The reading region retains keyboard focus and both persistent footer actions remain inside their clipping ancestors and viewport before helper scrolling.

steps.description: After capturing the lower text, use Home in the same focused reading region to return to the top without scrolling the document.
steps.acknowledgement: Home restores the top heading and chapter entry inside the bounded region.
verifications: Document scroll is unchanged, focus stays in Rules reading and the persistent actions remain contained.

steps.description: Use Back to menu, then reopen Rules and use Escape to return to its opening control.
steps.acknowledgement: Rules closes inside the still-open menu and restores Rules focus.
verifications: Presentation controls remain available and there is no second modal.

steps.description: Escape the menu and return focus to its original opener without route navigation.
steps.acknowledgement: The menu is closed and Menu regains focus.
verifications: The same gallery route remains mounted.
